runDialog.title: Start a DRY_RUN workflow
runDialog.description: Pack {pack}. The runner uses the worker model gateway; stub mode makes no external model calls.
runDialog.stubDesc: Deterministic responses, zero model cost. Uncheck to use the configured DeepSeek key.

runDialog.invalidEvidence: Evidence must be valid JSON (or leave it empty).

evolution.title: Evolution
evolution.description: Variants, shadow canary, and guarded promotion. Live traffic splitting is not enabled.
evolution.noCanary: No canary configured. Start one from the actions above; state is written to variants/state.json.
evolution.noCanaryNote: Evaluate scores champion and candidate on the same evidence. Rollback persists status; promotion remains a separate explicit action.
evolution.noVariantsDesc: Create a baseline and a candidate from the CLI, then score them. Example:
evolution.note: Scores come from variants/archive.jsonl; only agent files may change. Locked-file hash mismatches cause scoring to fail before any evaluation runs.
evolution.explainerBody: The team reviews its own failures, rewrites one role's instructions, tests the candidate against the same evidence, and keeps the result only if it beats the champion. You see every proposal, score, diff, and rollback. Promotion stays a separate, reversible step unless you explicitly allow automatic promotion.
evolution.stepSignalsBody: Failed gates, low scores, overrides, and cost anomalies become the hypothesis.
evolution.stepProposeBody: A meta-agent rewrites one agent file. Tools and permissions are frozen.
evolution.stepEvaluateBody: Champion and candidate run on the same evidence with an independent judge.
evolution.stepPromoteBody: Only improvements enter the archive. Canary compares pass rate, score, and cost before promotion.
evolution.explainerSafety: Evaluators and locked files are outside the writable surface; every promotion has a backup and a rollback path.
evolution.noCycles: No cycles yet. Run one to create a proposal, scores, and an archive record.

evolutionActions.startDesc: Shadow evaluation only. This does not split live traffic.
evolutionActions.evaluateDesc: The champion and candidate are scored on the same evidence. Non-stub runs call the real model.
evolutionActions.rollbackDesc: Marks the current canary as rolled back. State is persisted.
evolutionActions.promoteDesc: Dry run by default. Applying copies only agent files and creates a backup first.
evolutionActions.stubDesc: Deterministic checks, no model cost. Uncheck for live DeepSeek scoring.

traces.title: Traces
traces.description: Open the execution history. Jaeger carries OTel spans; Temporal carries workflow history.
traces.enterHint: Enter a run ID to pre-filter Jaeger spans by the run.id attribute.
traces.jaegerWorkerDesc: stage.run spans from the Temporal worker.
traces.jaegerCliDesc: kit.run spans emitted by CLI starts.
traces.footer: Jaeger runs as part of the local compose stack (UI on port 16686). If the page is unreachable, start it with bun run dev:up.

artifact.unavailable: Content is unavailable in this viewer. The web process and the worker may be using different blob backends; start the web app with the same KIT_BLOB_BACKEND as the worker.

studio.title: Pack Studio
studio.description: Edit the team's people, pipeline, approvals, and autonomy.
studio.invalidDesc: Only valid packs under packs/ can be edited. Fix the YAML first.
studio.footer: Files under packs/ are the source of truth. Every save is validated before it lands.
studio.confirmDeleteWorkflow: Delete workflow {id}? This cannot be undone.
studio.agentHint: This Markdown body is the role's prompt. The frontmatter is the structured contract; both are saved together.
studio.workflowHint: Raw YAML is the source of truth. Saving validates the whole pack before writing.
studio.approvalIntro: Choose where a human must approve. `before` pauses before a stage; `after` pauses after its output. `auto` only pauses when the auto-approve conditions are not met.
studio.autopilotHint: Schedules, budgets, auto-approval, and evolution cadence. Enable the daemon on the Autopilot page.

newPack.description: Pick a mold, name the team, and start. Everything becomes normal files under packs/.
newPack.managerPlaceholder: How should the manager handle exceptions?
newPack.getApproval: A starter approval on the final stage

newPack.footer: You can change everything later in Studio.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Discover community source adapters on GitHub, install them as data, and require explicit consent.
sources.securityNotice: Third-party sources are untrusted. Review their source.yaml and terms before installing. Sources are declarative data only; this Kit never executes their code and blocks private network targets.
sources.noInstalled: No third-party sources installed. Built-ins hn, arxiv, and github are always available.
sources.noResults: No sources found for this query.
sources.searchHint: Search the agent-team-source GitHub topic. Add GITHUB_TOKEN to raise API limits.
sources.confirmDescription: The Kit pins the current commit, stores a hash, and fetches only from the declared endpoint.
sources.confirmCheckbox: I reviewed the source.yaml, understand that it is third-party, and accept responsibility for its use and terms.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.description: Let the team run on schedule, within budgets, with a kill switch and an audit trail.
autopilot.offlineHint: The daemon is not running. Start it in a terminal; the console can still run a single tick.
autopilot.noPacks: No pack has an autopilot.yaml yet.
autopilot.noSchedules: No schedules. Add one in Studio → Autonomy.
autopilot.noAuto: No automatic decisions yet. They appear when a paused run matches the policy.

office.taskBoardHint: Tasks move from demand to build, delivery, block, or done.

newMission.noBuilders: No Builder role in this Pack
newMission.roleRules: Pack rules: Seller {seller} · Builder {builder} · combined roles {combined}
newMission.builderRequired: This Pack requires at least one Builder.
newMission.combinedForbidden: This Pack does not allow one agent to be Seller and Builder.

evolutionCycle.title: Run one evolution cycle
evolutionCycle.description: Collect failure signals, propose a role change, evaluate it, archive it, and optionally canary it.
evolutionCycle.stubHint: No model cost; real rubric scoring stays off.
evolutionCycle.autoApplyHint: Still requires an improvement and canary pass; a backup is created.
evolutionCycle.forceHint: Off: the cycle is skipped when the archive has no failures.
